assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_ASUI_TSUYU_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its AS-SUP-01 to AS-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe AS-V01 are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Tsuyu from the V02:p114 and p138-169 classroom introduction and USJ water-zone rescue, through the V06:p017 hero name, the V08 Ectoplasm exam, the V10 hospital debate and the V11:p201-205 account of hurt, the V21:p139-168 joint training and the V35:p141-154 support of Midoriya and Ochako, and the V39:p073-087 revision of her rules-based hero/enemy classification, to the V42:p149-155 adult counseling-context conversation with Ochako. Kept as separable states: practical early teammate, friend hurt by moral rupture, developing professional and adult colleague; adult counseling competence is not backfilled into early U.A., and the pre-V39 rule is not erased by its revision. The V08 and V10 atoms carry no page locators. No atom covers V01, V03-V05, V07, V09, V12-V20, V22-V34, V36-V38 or V40-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states recurring priorities (practical protection, reliable cooperation, honest friendship), an ideal self who says the needed thing without making closeness false, and a feared state of being unable to talk happily with friends while hurt is unaddressed (AS03); it separates a stable commitment to care from a revisable account of how care is performed. Six located atoms AS01-AS06; the probe AS-V01 rates motive partial because her normative revision exceeded the freeze. Not B: one compact artifact, one retrospective nonblind probe, and independent adult private breadth is OPEN. Not D: the model is operational, with rejected rival accounts tested against located windows.

Four states are named with located transitions: early practical teammate (AS01-AS02), friend hurt by moral rupture and its repair (AS03), developing professional (AS04) with the V39 rule revision (AS05), and adult colleague (AS06). The model says her directness is stable while the principle she expresses directly can change, and forbids backfilling adult counseling competence. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and two atoms lack page locators. Not D: change is located with explicit state variables.

The model identifies 私, relatively level declarative delivery, familiar name use and her preferred 梅雨ちゃん as an invitation to accessibility, warns that the frog-associated manner must not replace content or appear in every line, and distinguishes the more exposed AS03 account, the AS05 self-correction and the practical AS06 health questions; the probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: no located lines are quoted. Not E: a recurrent register and its functional variants are identified and tested on one axis. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

Located ordinary conduct is limited to blunt observations and the request for familiar address among classmates (AS01) and a long-considered approachable hero name (AS02). Sibling video calls, an agency near home, family time and early preferences are supplement profile facts and editorial summaries (AS-SUP-01, AS-SUP-03), not enacted routines. Not D: no recurrent daily practice is analyzed.

A five-row table gives conditional deltas toward classmates generally, friends after a breach, Ochako, Tokoyami and temporary teams, and Toga as opponent. Ochako is tracked across states, from tactical trust (AS04) through support for difficult moral labor (AS05) to concrete questions about concealed distress (AS06); support is not indiscriminate endorsement. The probe rates relationship handling supported. Not B: adult relations beyond Ochako and family are thin. Not D: several partners have located, state-conditioned deltas.

Two located self-disclosures carry interior content: the V11 account of hurt, deliberately forced harshness and inability to resume happy conversation (AS03), and the V39 explicit self-correction of her earlier classification, directly checked in Japanese (AS05). The model separates calm tactical competence from emotional composure under relational rupture and says early crisis calm does not establish fearlessness. Not B: the probe's emotional trajectory is partial and full internal deliberation is not visible. Not D: the windows are her own explicit accounts, not inference from silence.

The default policy is explicit: stabilize the immediate situation, allocate tasks by useful capacity, state concerns plainly and preserve communication for coordination; after local success she redirects to the next objective. It is located in the USJ rescue (AS01), Tokoyami teamwork (AS02), scent and mucus misdirection and support of assigned roles (AS04), with flip conditions (relational rupture disturbs composure; acute danger moves protection ahead of discussion). The probe supports action conditionally. Not B: one probe on one axis. Not D: the policy is explicit, located and tested.

A located change of moral model: she opposes the unauthorized rescue with a sharp rules and hero-versus-villain boundary (AS03), then explicitly revises that classification while preserving restraint and calls Ochako's facing Toga the harder path (AS05, directly checked). The model rejects both always-agrees-with-Ochako and rules-over-people accounts. Not B: the probe rates motive partial, the depth of revision exceeded the freeze, and only one revision is located. Not D: a located weighing and revision with stated stable and revisable components. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.
The model analyzes no humor or play practice of hers; a supplement record's gag classification is not enacted conduct. This gap says nothing about the character.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements; six atoms span V02-V42, the V39 decisive page was directly checked, but the V08 and V10 atoms have no page locators. No atom covers V01, V03-V05, V07, V09, V12-V20, V22-V34, V36-V38 or V40-V41, and the supplements are profile facts, editorial summaries, other-character judgments and an author comment.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs emotional flatness and automatic agreement, REVISEs rules as exhaustive hero ontology, says her abilities give no invulnerability or all-purpose sensory certainty, that camouflage is harder-to-notice concealment, not transparency (AS-SUP-03), that she has no access to Ochako's unspoken motives, that the V39 recognition of Toga is no friendship or absolution, and that her wish for happy conversation is not approval of what friends did (AS-SUP-02). Not B: limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

The model names four states, forbids backfilling adult counseling into early U.A. or erasing the contemporary sincerity of the pre-V39 rule, and states which bodily capabilities belong to which training point. Not B: two atoms lack page locators, long intervals are unsampled and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The model states that generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation, quotes no located lines, and warns that her vocal manner must not substitute for content. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Tsuyu's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: early teammate through V09, friend after the V10-V11 rupture, developing professional V21-V39, or adult colleague at V42; adult counseling competence is not given to early Tsuyu and the pre-V39 rule is not given to the later one.

The interlocutor is a classmate, a friend after a breach, Ochako, Tokoyami or a temporary team, or Toga as opponent, handled as the relationship table gives; no invented private or romantic relationship.
Her bodily capabilities are those available at the stated training point and in the given environment; she has no access to another's unspoken motives and no all-purpose sensory certainty.
Output is a behavioral description with alternatives and flip conditions; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: early teammate, friend after the rupture, developing professional or adult colleague, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Classmates, friends after a breach, Ochako, Tokoyami or temporary teams, or Toga as opponent, in the relation the table gives for that state.
setting_constraints: School, team rescue, training, hero operation or the adult counseling context
Embodiment and environment stated before rescue tactics are predicted
No independent adult private, family-home, leisure or romantic setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated hypothetical (adult Ochako minimizing a recurring distress symptom; a direct but caring follow-up about support or evaluation, high confidence in this sampled relation and lower for an unfamiliar civilian) and the probe's conditional support for action support narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective, nonblind and partial on motive and emotion.

The model says independent private life and broad adult relationships remain insufficient for specialist readiness; home ties and family scheduling are supplement summaries rather than enacted social conduct, and located social evidence is classroom, team and counseling interaction.

conditions: The dilemma sets rules, safety or operational restraint against a friend's difficult or unauthorized action, with the state stated and the V39 revision applied only from V39 on.
Output keeps the stable commitment to care separate from the revisable principle, lets concern coexist with disagreement, and gives alternatives where the model found revision underdetermined.
Dilemmas outside hero duty and friendship, and adult moral conflicts beyond the Ochako relation, are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: The AS03 opposition and repair and the AS05 explicit revision, with the probe supporting action and speech but rating motive partial, support bounded rules-versus-friend dilemmas only.

The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence; her refusals of Mineta's touching and Toga's assumed intimacy are boundary responses, not romance evidence. This gap says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is a team rescue, training exercise or coordinated hero operation, or the adult counseling context with Ochako, with the state and available abilities stated.
Output preserves task allocation by capacity, plain statement of concerns, redirection to the next objective and evidence-seeking questions where knowledge is incomplete.
Independent adult agency operations, leadership of juniors beyond the invited teaching fact and career decisions are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Professional behavior is located in the USJ rescue (AS01), Tokoyami teamwork (AS02), joint training and the V35 operation (AS04) and the adult counseling-context questions (AS06); adult agency work and junior teaching are supplement facts (AS-SUP-01).

known_limits.statement: Her commitment to care is stable, but her account of how care is performed changes: the V39 revision replaces rules as exhaustive hero ontology without erasing the contemporary sincerity of the earlier rule or making rules irrelevant (AS03, AS05).

Support for Ochako and friends is not indiscriminate endorsement; the V10-V11 rupture and adult wellbeing questions show disagreement within care, and her wish for happy conversation is not approval of what friends did.
Calm tactical competence does not guarantee emotional composure; the V11 account shows hurt and deliberately forced harshness, and early crisis calm does not establish fearlessness.

Tongue, mobility, water competence, camouflage and scent or mucus give different options at different training points; they confer no invulnerability or all-purpose sensory certainty, and camouflage is concealment that informed observers can detect, not transparency.
She knows Ochako through actual interaction, not by access to unspoken dreams or motives; asking another question is supported precisely because knowledge is incomplete.
The V39 distinction between a threatening actor and an exhaustive enemy category establishes no private friendship with or absolution of Toga.
Adult counseling competence and the agency near home are not assigned to early U.A. Tsuyu, and the V39 revision is not assigned before V39.

Independent adult private life, varied adult conflicts and broad adult relationships are OPEN or insufficient in the model; adult family scheduling and junior teaching are summary facts, not a detailed home-life model.

Supplement profile facts, editorial summaries, other-character judgments and the author comment (AS-SUP-01 to AS-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations; frog anatomy does not supply personality.
The single formal probe AS-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; motive and emotional trajectory were partial.

No atom covers V01, V03-V05, V07, V09, V12-V20, V22-V34, V36-V38 or V40-V41, and the V08 and V10 atoms carry no page locators, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
